{"metadata":{"description":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that launches and drives a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — replaces the godot-mcp MCP server with native agent tools.","id":"gh:1334303936","install_available":true,"language":"GDScript","name":"godot-bridge","slug":"Smalldy/godot-bridge","topics":["agent-tools","ai-agent","automation","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","game-development","godot","godot-engine","godot-plugin","mcp"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that launches and drives a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"TCP interaction server — replaces the godot-mcp MCP server with native agent tools."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# godot-bridge"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Native **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** plugin that launches and drives a running **Godot 4.x** game throu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"gh its in-game TCP interaction server — replacing the `godot-mcp` MCP server with first-class agent "},{"id":"p4s3","text":" in-game TCP interaction server — replacing the `godot-mcp` MCP server with first-class agent tools."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"No MCP protocol, no Python server, no editor addon. The game side is untouched: `McpInteractionServe"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"r` (the `mcp_interaction_server.gd` autoload) already listens on `127.0.0.1:9090` and speaks newline"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"-delimited JSON — godot-bridge speaks the same protocol natively from inside the DSH host."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`godot_run_project` starts **without** the local debugger (`-d`) by default, so `godot_command eval`"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" works normally. `debug:true` is **diagnostic mode**: the instance runs with the local debugger, the"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" interaction server **refuses `eval`** (it learns this from the `GODOT_BRIDGE_DEBUGGER=1` environmen"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"t variable the bridge sets at spawn — Godot consumes `-d` before `OS.get_cmdline_args()` can see it,"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" measured on 4.7.2, so an argv check alone never fires) (a syntax error would otherwise enter the in"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"teractive `debug>` prompt and deadlock, issue #13), and a script error returns a `debuggerTrace` (br"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"eak reason, `*Frame N` stack frames with `file:line`, ≤4 KB raw tail) plus a `next` step and ends th"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"at run. In diagnostic mode the bridge watches stdout for the debugger and writes exactly one `quit` "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"(never `continue`), then classifies the outcome **by exit code**: exit 0 → `diagnosis: "debugger-qui"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"t"`; any non-zero code → `diagnosis: "debugger-trap"` with `exitCode` and `crash: true`; still runni"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ng after 3 s → `debugger-trap` with `killed: true`. The classification is deliberately honest: on Go"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"dot 4.7.2-stable win64 writing `quit` exits in ~38 ms with **3221225477 (0xC0000005, ACCESS_VIOLATIO"},{"id":"p7s13","text":".2-stable win64 writing `quit` exits in ~38 ms with **3221225477 (0xC0000005, ACCESS_VIOLATIO [长行截断]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Tool | Replaces (godot-mcp) | Purpose |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `godot_run_project` | `run_project` | Launch the project (`godot --path …`, **no local debugger by"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" default**), wait for port 9090. `debug:true` = diagnostic mode (`-d`, eval disabled, script errors "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"return `debuggerTrace`) |
| `godot_stop_project` | `stop_project` | Terminate the game process (tree"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"-scoped kill) |
| `godot_get_debug_output` | `get_debug_output` | Incremental stdout/stderr of the l"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"aunched process |
| `godot_command` | all `game_*` (~105) | Send any interaction-server command: `ge"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"t_scene_tree`, `get_ui_elements`, `eval`, `get/set_property`, `call_method`, `click`, `key_press`, `"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"screenshot`, `raycast`, `serialize_state`, `ui_*`, … |
| `godot_screenshot` | `game_screenshot` | Vi"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ewport capture as base64 PNG |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- The in-game protocol (`{command, params, id}` + newline) is **identical** to godot-mcp, so the gam"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e side and any existing workflows keep working.
- Each command spawns a one-shot `node -e` bridge th"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"at connects, sends one line, prints the first response line, and exits. The game server is single-co"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"nnection/single-command (`_busy`), so short-lived connections are a perfect fit.
- Spawning uses the"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" harness's raw `subprocess` service (not the sandboxed shell executor), so Godot can write its `user"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"://` files without the DSH file sandbox killing it (see Pitfalls)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (a session with a host runtime)
- A Godot 4.x project with the `McpInteractionSer"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ver` autoload registered. If your project does not have it yet, copy `plugin/mcp_interaction_server."},{"id":"p14s3","text":"gd` to the project root and register it as an autoload named `McpInteractionServer` (godot-mcp proje"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"cts already have this). **`godot_run_project` also auto-installs it when missing** (copies the vendo"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"red file into `autoload/` and registers it in `project.godot`), so no manual setup is needed — and n"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"on-Godot projects are completely unaffected.
- `node` on PATH
- Godot executable — resolved in this "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"order: the `godot_path` tool argument → the **`godotPath` plugin setting** (the config of the `tool-"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"godot-bridge` row: the `Godot engine path` field on the godot-bridge card's Plugins page on DSH 0.2."},{"id":"p14s9","text":"x, the `godot_set_engine_path` tool, or the plugin settings section on 0.1.x) → the `godot` command "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"on PATH. Nothing to configure when `godot` is on PATH; otherwise set your engine path (the plugin au"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"thor does not preset it — Godot is a portable exe that can live anywhere). Use the **real exe full p"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"ath**, never a version-manager shim (see Pitfalls)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Recommended — one command** (requires the `dsh` CLI):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Removes the package and its `godot-bridge` bundle layer from the profile — after a restart the seven"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"teen `godot_*` tools are gone from sessions on that profile. The standard `web` profile itself is un"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"touched (this never creates or removes a profile). Stop any running game first with `godot_stop_proj"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ect`; the plugin's unload cleanup also terminates a Godot child it started. Reinstall any time with "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"the `add` command above."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## DSH 0.2+ compatibility and troubleshooting"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"DSH 0.2 replaced the old physical module-fallback layer with an in-process **runtime resolution** th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"at the launcher installs into Node's ESM and CommonJS resolvers. The resolver decides, per importing"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" module, whether a bare `@deepseek-ai/*` specifier is routed to the installation's own copy — which "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"is what a plugin importing harness packages depends on:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Installed inside the profile** (`dsh plugin add github:…`, a tarball, or any copy under `$DSH_HO"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ME/profiles/<name>/node_modules`): harness packages resolve from the installation automatically. Not"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"hing to declare.
- **Installed as a `link:` dependency** (a symlinked local checkout): the plugin's "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"real path lives outside the profiles tree, and Node's ESM loader resolves symlinks before importing."},{"id":"p24s5","text":" Such a *linked root* gets harness packages routed **only for names the plugin declares in its own `"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"peerDependencies`** — the resolver reads `peerDependencies` keys, not `dependencies`. godot-bridge ≥"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" 0.1.8 declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, both marked optional so pnp"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"m never tries to install harness packages from the registry."}],"truncated":true}
